comparisons.comparison: MS and JPM both disclosed specific volume changes in loans and lending-related commitments for 2024, attributing growth to Institutional Securities/Corporate lending and Wealth Management/Asset & Wealth Management activities. MS reported a net $47 billion increase in total loans and commitments, driven by Institutional Securities (Corporate lending and Secured lending) and Wealth Management. JPM reported a $19.8 billion increase in loans (driven by CIB and securities-based lending in AWM) but a $5.3 billion decrease in lending-related commitments (offset by CIB growth), showing a more mixed or segmented performance between loans and commitments compared to MS's unified growth.

sentences.text: In 2024, total loans and lending commitments increased by approximately $47 billion, primarily due to an increase in Corporate lending commitments and Secured lending facilities within the Institutional Securities business segment, and growth across portfolios within the Wealth Management business segment.
As of December 31, 2024, loans increased $19.8 billion, driven by higher loans in CIB and higher securities-based lending in AWM.
Lending-related commitments decreased $5.3 billion, with decreases in AWM and CCB, largely offset by higher commitments in CIB.
